"};for(const [p,u] of Object.entries(MUSEUM_ASSETS))document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--asset-'+p.split('/').pop().split('.')[0],'url("'+u+'")');</script></head>
<body><a href="#main" class="skip">跳到内容</a><div class="world" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="dust" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<header><a href="#home" class="brand"><span class="sigil">✧</span><span>未完成博物馆<small>The Unfinished Museum</small></span></a><nav aria-label="主导航"><a href="#explore">探索展馆</a><a href="#create">留下藏品</a><a href="#inspire">发现灵感</a><a href="#about">关于我们</a></nav><div class="header-actions"><button id="motion" class="icon-button" aria-label="关闭动态效果" title="切换动态效果">◌</button><button id="theme" class="icon-button" aria-label="切换中式书斋" title="切换场景风格">◐</button><a class="outline pill" href="#mine">我的展馆 ↗</a></div></header>

<dialog id="assistant" class="assistant"><button class="close" aria-label="关闭灵感手札">×</button><span class="eyebrow">THE INSPIRATION COMPANION</span><h2>让想法，再走一步。</h2><p class="muted">这本手札提供本地引导问题与方法清单，尚未连接 AI 服务。作品由你创作。</p><div id="assistant-context"></div><label>你想探索什么？<textarea id="idea-input" rows="3" maxlength="1000" placeholder="例如：想把这个故事变成一组照片"></textarea></label><div class="mode-tabs"><button data-mode="打开思路">打开思路</button><button data-mode="理清想法">理清想法</button><button data-mode="分析难点">分析难点</button><button data-mode="寻找实现方法">寻找实现方法</button></div><div id="advice" aria-live="polite"></div></dialog>
<dialog id="confirm-dialog"><h2 id="confirm-title"></h2><p id="confirm-copy"></p><div class="button-row"><button id="confirm-no">取消</button><button id="confirm-yes" class="gold">确认</button></div></dialog>
<div id="portal" aria-hidden="true"><div>✧</div><span>正在翻开新的篇章</span></div><div id="toast" role="status"></div><script>const pics={flower:'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1490750967868-88aa4486c946?w=1000&auto=format&fit=crop&q=85',sea:'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1475924156734-496f6cac6ec1?w=700&auto=format&fit=crop&q=85',room:'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1449247709967-d4461a6a6103?w=700&auto=format&fit=crop&q=85'};
const seeds=[{id:'letter',title:'第十三封，没有寄出的信',category:'文字与信笺',author:'南枝',year:'2019',mood:'停在这里也很好',kind:'letter-art',excerpt:'“有些话，写下来就已经抵达了。”',story:'亲爱的你：\n\n今天路过从前那家花店，门口的风铃还是同样的声音。\n我原本想告诉你，这些年我终于学会了照顾一盆植物。\n\n写到这里，我停了很久。\n前十二封信都寄出了，最后这一封，一直留在抽屉里。如今我想，写下来就已经抵达了。',remix:false},{id:'bookshop',title:'一家只在纸上开过的书店',category:'生活与计划',author:'林间',year:'2021',mood:'也许有一天继续',kind:'plan',excerpt:'“十几个店名，最后都成了书签。”',story:'一张手绘平面图，三页预算，还有十几个备选店名。\n\n我想在窗边留一张长桌，下雨时请路过的人喝茶。后来我去了另一座城市。现在已经不想开店了，但还是舍不得删掉这些。\n\n如果有一天你开了一家小书店，希望它也有一扇很大的窗。',remix:true},{id:'sea',title:'那年夏天，胶卷还剩三张',category:'绘画与影像',author:'阿屿',year:'2020',mood:'停在这里也很好',image:pics.sea,excerpt:'“本来想拍完整个夏天。”',story:'本来想拍完整个夏天，最后只留下了这一片海。\n\n没拍完的三张，留给下次见面。\n\n这是一件用于初版体验的示例藏品，图片为氛围配图。',remix:false},{id:'music',title:'一首只写了前奏的歌',category:'声音与旋律',author:'迟迟',year:'2023',mood:'欢迎别人延伸',kind:'music',excerpt:'“十六小节之后，我还没想好。”',story:'那天傍晚，雨滴落在阳台栏杆上。我记下了这段旋律，却一直找不到适合它的歌词。\n\n想象它轻轻开始，然后往某个意外的方向走。你会给它一个怎样的名字？\n\n此为文字描述示例，尚未附上真实音频。',remix:true},{id:'flower',title:'等春天再画完的花',category:'绘画与影像',author:'鹿眠',year:'2022',mood:'也许有一天继续',image:pics.flower,excerpt:'“花已经谢了，颜色还在等。”',story:'画到一半，窗外的花期结束了。\n\n我把调色盘收起来，想着等下一个春天。后来过了几个春天，这张画还在。\n\n初版示例藏品，图片为氛围配图。',remix:true},{id:'room',title:'给未来的自己，留一间房',category:'生活与计划',author:'木一',year:'2024',mood:'也许有一天继续',image:pics.room,excerpt:'“窗边要有阳光，其他还没想好。”',story:'一个关于理想居所的小计划：一张桌子，一盏灯，一个可以安静读书的下午。\n\n清单还没写完，生活倒是先往前走了。\n\n初版示例藏品，图片为氛围配图。',remix:false}];
</script><script>/* Data rules shared by the interface and regression checks. */
(function(root){
 const categories=['文字与信笺','绘画与影像','声音与旋律','生活与计划','链接与档案'];
 const moods=['停在这里也很好','也许有一天继续','欢迎别人延伸'];
 function imageSafe(v){return typeof v==='string'&&(!v||/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|webp);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/.test(v)||/^https:\/\//.test(v))}
 function linkSafe(v){try{const u=new URL(v);return ['https:','http:'].includes(u.protocol)?u.href:''}catch{return ''}}
 function normalize(x){if(!x||typeof x!=='object'||typeof x.id!=='string'||!x.id||x.id.length>100||typeof x.title!=='string'||!x.title.trim()||typeof x.story!=='string')throw Error('藏品格式不完整');if(x.title.length>70||x.story.length>10000||!imageSafe(x.image||'')||(x.image||'').length>2900000)throw Error('藏品内容超出限制或图片格式不支持');return {id:x.id,title:x.title.trim(),story:x.story,author:String(x.author||'一位收藏者').slice(0,30),category:categories.includes(x.category)?x.category:categories[0],mood:moods.includes(x.mood)?x.mood:moods[0],visibility:x.visibility==='public'?'public':'private',remix:x.remix===true,image:x.image||'',link:linkSafe(x.link||''),invitation:String(x.invitation||'').slice(0,1000),parent:typeof x.parent==='string'?x.parent:null,root:typeof x.root==='string'?x.root:null,year:String(x.year||new Date().getFullYear()).slice(0,4),createdAt:Number(x.createdAt)||Date.now(),updatedAt:Number(x.updatedAt)||Date.now(),deleted:x.deleted===true,draft:x.draft===true,mine:true,contentType:String(x.contentType||"文字").slice(0,20),unfinishedReason:String(x.unfinishedReason||"").slice(0,2000),futureMessage:String(x.futureMessage||"").slice(0,2000),sealedAt:Number(x.sealedAt)||null,media:mediaMeta(x.media)};}
 function mediaMeta(x){if(!x)return null;if(typeof x.id!=='string'||!x.id||x.id.length>100||typeof x.name!=='string'||!['audio/mpeg','audio/mp3','audio/wav','audio/x-wav','audio/ogg','audio/mp4','audio/webm','video/mp4','video/webm','video/quicktime'].includes(x.type)||!Number.isFinite(x.size)||x.size<0||x.size>20*1024*1024)throw Error('音视频附件信息无效');return {id:x.id,name:x.name.slice(0,200),type:x.type,size:x.size}}
 function active(items){return items.filter(x=>!x.deleted&&!x.draft)}
 function rootOf(id,items){const map=new Map(items.map(x=>[x.id,x]));let x=map.get(id);const seen=new Set();while(x?.parent&&map.has(x.parent)&&!seen.has(x.id)){seen.add(x.id);x=map.get(x.parent)}return x||map.get(id)}
 function checkGraph(items){const map=new Map(items.map(x=>[x.id,x]));if(map.size!==items.length)throw Error('备份中存在重复藏品编号');for(const x of items){let cur=x;const seen=new Set();while(cur){if(seen.has(cur.id))throw Error('作品来源不能形成循环');seen.add(cur.id);cur=map.get(cur.parent)}}}
 function mergeBackup(current,payload,reserved=[]){const raw=Array.isArray(payload)?payload:payload?.items;if(!Array.isArray(raw)||raw.length>500)throw Error('请选择有效备份，最多 500 件藏品');const incoming=raw.map(normalize);if(incoming.some(x=>reserved.includes(x.id)))throw Error('备份编号与示例藏品冲突');checkGraph(incoming);const map=new Map(current.map(x=>[x.id,x]));let added=0,skipped=0;for(const x of incoming){if(map.has(x.id)){skipped++;continue}map.set(x.id,x);added++}const items=[...map.values()];checkGraph(items);return {items,added,skipped}}
 const api={categories,moods,imageSafe,linkSafe,normalize,active,rootOf,checkGraph,mergeBackup};if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;else root.MuseumCore=api;
})(typeof globalThis!=='undefined'?globalThis:this);
</script><script>const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)], C=MuseumCore;
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const icons={'文字与信笺':'✎','绘画与影像':'▧','声音与旋律':'♬','生活与计划':'⌘','链接与档案':'↗'};
function read(k,f){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k))??f}catch{return f}}
let own=read('museum-items',[]);if(!Array.isArray(own))own=[];own=own.filter(x=>x&&typeof x.title==='string'&&typeof x.story==='string').map(x=>({...x,mine:true}));
let saved=read('museum-saved',[]);if(!Array.isArray(saved))saved=[];
let reactions=read('museum-reactions',{}),comments=read('museum-comments',{}),profile=read('museum-profile',{name:'我的未完成书房',bio:'那些舍不得丢掉的，都可以留在这里。'}),theme=read('museum-theme','european');
let filter='全部藏品',query='',sort='curated',tab='我的未完成',view='wall',currentId=null,editingId=null,sourceId=null,attachment='';
const extra=[{id:'summer',title:'没有结尾的夏天',author:'小晨',category:'文字与信笺',year:'2026',mood:'欢迎别人延伸',remix:true,kind:'letter-art',story:'夏天结束的前一天，我们在旧车站碰面。\n\n她带着一台没有胶卷的相机，我拿着两张没有日期的车票。列车迟迟没有到站，广播里却响起了我们十年前录下的声音。\n\n“下一站，你想去哪里？”\n\n我把故事停在了这个问题上。',invitation:'如果那列车终于来了，它会带他们去哪里？欢迎用文字、绘画、照片或声音，留下你的答案。'},{id:'summer-photo',parent:'summer',root:'summer',title:'车站尽头的一片海',author:'阿屿',category:'绘画与影像',year:'2026',mood:'也许有一天继续',remix:true,image:pics.sea,story:'我想，他们走出了车站，没有坐上那列车。\n\n沿着铁轨一直走，最后看见了一片海。\n\n摄影方向的示例延伸，图片为氛围配图。'},{id:'summer-song',parent:'summer',root:'summer',title:'末班车之前的旋律',author:'迟迟',category:'声音与旋律',year:'2026',mood:'欢迎别人延伸',remix:true,kind:'music',story:'把故事里那段旧广播想象成旋律：先是轻轻的钢琴，然后只剩风声。\n\n这是一份配乐构想示例，尚未附音频。',invitation:'你会用哪一种声音，表现等待？'}];
const demo=[...extra,...seeds].map((x,i)=>({...x,visibility:'public',createdAt:Date.now()-i*86400000}));
const all=()=>[...own,...demo], available=()=>[...C.active(own),...demo];
function write(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v));return true}catch{toast('保存失败：存储空间不足或浏览器禁止保存，请导出备份。');return false}}
function commit(items){if(!write('museum-items',items))return false;own=items;return true}
let toastTimer;function toast(s){$('#toast').textContent=s;$('#toast').classList.add('visible');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('#toast').classList.remove('visible'),3500)}
function confirmAction(title,copy,fn){$('#confirm-title').textContent=title;$('#confirm-copy').textContent=copy;$('#confirm-dialog').showModal();$('#confirm-no').onclick=()=>$('#confirm-dialog').close();$('#confirm-yes').onclick=()=>{$('#confirm-dialog').close();fn()}}
const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');let motion=read('museum-motion',!reduced.matches);
function applyPrefs(){document.body.classList.toggle('chinese',theme==='chinese');document.body.classList.toggle('still',!motion||reduced.matches);$('#motion').setAttribute('aria-label',motion?'关闭动态效果':'打开动态效果');$('#motion').textContent=motion?'◌':'◎';$('#theme').setAttribute('aria-label',theme==='chinese'?'切换欧式图书馆':'切换中式书斋')}
applyPrefs();reduced.addEventListener('change',applyPrefs);$('#motion').onclick=()=>{motion=!motion;write('museum-motion',motion);applyPrefs();toast(motion?'动态效果已打开':'已进入静态阅读模式')};$('#theme').onclick=()=>{theme=theme==='chinese'?'european':'chinese';write('museum-theme',theme);applyPrefs();toast(theme==='chinese'?'已切换至东方藏书阁':'已切换至魔法图书馆')};
function art(x){if(x.image&&C.imageSafe(x.image))return `<img src="${esc(x.image)}" alt="${esc(x.title)}" loading="lazy">`;if(x.category==='声音与旋律')return '<div class="record"><i></i><span>♪</span></div>';if(x.category==='生活与计划')return '<div class="idea-bottle"><span>✧</span></div>';return `<div class="book-object"><span class="book-corner">✧</span><small>${esc(x.author)}</small><strong>${esc(x.title)}</strong><span class="book-line"></span><p>${esc(x.story.slice(0,36))}</p><small>未完 · 待续</small></div>`}
function card(x){return `<article class="artifact" style="--delay:${(x.title.length%5)*.3}s"><button class="artifact-open" data-open="${esc(x.id)}" aria-label="查看${esc(x.title)}"><div class="artifact-media ${x.image?'framed':''}">${art(x)}${x.mine?`<span class="seal">${x.deleted?'暂存':x.draft?'草稿':x.visibility==='private'?'私密封印':'公开展出'}</span>`:''}</div><div class="artifact-label"><span>${icons[x.category]||'✧'} ${esc(x.category)}<span class="demo-tag">${x.mine?'我的藏品':'示例'}</span></span><h3>${esc(x.title)}</h3><p>${esc(x.excerpt||x.story.slice(0,38))}</p><div><small>${esc(x.author)}</small><small>${esc(x.year)} · ${x.remix?'可延伸':'仅欣赏'}</small></div></div></button></article>`}
function home(){return `<section class="hero"><div class="hero-kicker"><span></span> A SANCTUARY FOR THE UNFINISHED <span></span></div><div class="hero-mark">✧</div><h1>未完成博物馆</h1><p class="english-title">The Unfinished Museum</p><p class="hero-sub">让每一个未完成，成为无限可能的开始。</p><div class="hero-cta"><a class="gold pill" href="#explore">进入开放展馆 <span>→</span></a><a class="ghost-link" href="#mine">我的个人展馆 ↗</a></div><div class="floating-page page-one" aria-hidden="true"><small>CHAPTER Ⅰ</small><span>未寄出的信</span><i>有些话，写下来<br>就已经抵达。</i></div><div class="floating-page page-two" aria-hidden="true"><span>没有结尾<br>的夏天</span><i>The story goes on…</i></div><div class="hero-side"><a href="#explore"><b>01</b> 进入馆藏</a><a href="#inspire"><b>02</b> 发现灵感</a><a href="#create"><b>03</b> 加入创作</a></div><div class="hero-note">写下一个未完成的故事<br>留下一张未洗完的照片<br>收藏一个未被证实的想法<br><em>让想象，在这里继续。</em></div><div class="hero-bottom"><div><strong>${available().length}</strong><span>此刻可探索的藏品</span></div><i></i><div><strong>${available().filter(x=>x.remix).length}</strong><span>开放的创作邀请</span></div><i></i><div><strong>∞</strong><span>还未发生的可能</span></div></div><a href="#rooms" class="scroll-cue">向下探索 ↓</a></section><section class="rooms" id="rooms"><div class="section-heading"><span class="eyebrow">CHOOSE YOUR NEXT CHAPTER</span><h2>推开一扇门，走进一种可能。</h2><p>宏大的想象，也可以从一件很小的未完成开始。</p></div><div class="room-grid"><a href="#explore" class="room room-public"><span>01 / THE OPEN GALLERY</span><h3>开放展馆</h3><p>探索他人留下的故事，与不同的想象相遇。</p><b>进入展馆 →</b></a><a href="#mine" class="room room-private"><span>02 / YOUR PRIVATE STUDY</span><h3>个人展馆</h3><p>给那些舍不得丢掉的片段，留一个温暖的位置。</p><b>回到书房 →</b></a></div></section><section class="featured"><div class="section-heading"><span class="eyebrow">STORIES WAITING TO BE DISCOVERED</span><h2>未完，待你发现。</h2><p>示例策展 · 每一个停顿，都可以通向另一个故事。</p></div><div class="artifact-grid">${demo.slice(0,3).map(card).join('')}</div><a href="#explore" class="outline pill">探索全部藏品 ↗</a></section>`}
function toolbar(mine){const tabs=mine?['我的未完成','我的延伸','私密展品','我的收藏','草稿箱','回收站']:['全部藏品',...C.categories];return `<div class="gallery-controls"><div class="filter-list" role="group" aria-label="藏品分类">${tabs.map(t=>`<button data-filter="${t}" class="${(mine?tab:filter)===t?'active':''}">${t}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="search-row"><label class="search-box"><span>⌕</span><input id="search" value="${esc(query)}" placeholder="寻找一个故事、一位创作者…" aria-label="搜索藏品"></label><select id="sort" aria-label="藏品排序"><option value="curated">策展顺序</option><option value="new">最近入藏</option><option value="title">按名称</option></select></div></div><div class="result-line"><span id="result-count" aria-live="polite"></span><span>点击藏品，翻开它的故事</span></div><div class="artifact-grid" id="gallery-grid"></div>`}
function explore(){return `<section class="gallery-page"><div class="page-heading"><span class="eyebrow">THE OPEN GALLERY · 开放展馆</span><h1>漂浮的创意，<em>等待一次相遇。</em></h1><p>这里收藏着未写完的故事、停笔的画，以及尚未发生的人生计划。</p></div><div class="local-notice">✧ 当前为本地体验：预置藏品为示例。新作品保存在此浏览器，公开展出仅在本机可见。</div>${toolbar(false)}</section>`}
function mine(){return `<section class="gallery-page private-room"><div class="page-heading"><span class="eyebrow">YOUR PRIVATE STUDY</span><div class="title-row"><div><h1>${esc(profile.name||'我的未完成书房')}</h1><p>${esc(profile.bio||'')}</p></div><button id="edit-profile" class="outline">布置书房 ✎</button></div><div class="study-stats"><span>${C.active(own).length} 件藏品</span><span>${own.filter(x=>x.draft&&!x.deleted).length} 份草稿</span><span>${saved.length} 个收藏</span></div></div><div class="local-notice backup-bar"><span>私密封印仅代表本机展示范围；请定期导出，清除浏览数据将失去本地记录。</span><div><button id="export" class="text-button">导出备份 ↓</button><label class="import-label">恢复备份 ↑<input id="import" type="file" accept="application/json,.json"></label></div></div>${toolbar(true)}</section>`}
function fillGrid(){const minePage=location.hash==='#mine';let list=minePage?(tab==='我的收藏'?available().filter(x=>saved.includes(x.id)):tab==='回收站'?own.filter(x=>x.deleted):tab==='草稿箱'?own.filter(x=>x.draft&&!x.deleted):C.active(own).filter(x=>tab==='我的延伸'?!!x.parent:tab==='私密展品'?x.visibility==='private':!x.parent)):available().filter(x=>!x.mine||x.visibility==='public');if(!minePage&&filter!=='全部藏品')list=list.filter(x=>x.category===filter);list=list.filter(x=>[x.title,x.author,x.story,x.invitation].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase()));if(sort==='new')list.sort((a,b)=>(b.createdAt||0)-(a.createdAt||0));if(sort==='title')list.sort((a,b)=>a.title.localeCompare(b.title,'zh'));$('#gallery-grid').innerHTML=list.length?list.map(card).join(''):`<div class="empty-state"><span>✧</span><h3>${query?'还没有找到这个故事':'这里，还留着一个位置。'}</h3><p>${query?'换个词试试，或探索其他类别。':'不必完整，也不必准备好。'}</p><a class="outline pill" href="#create">留下我的藏品 ↗</a></div>`;$('#result-count').textContent=`共 ${list.length} 件${minePage&&tab==='回收站'?'暂存藏品':'藏品'}`;bindOpen()}
function bindGallery(){fillGrid();$('#search').oninput=e=>{query=e.target.value;fillGrid()};$('#sort').value=sort;$('#sort').onchange=e=>{sort=e.target.value;fillGrid()};$$('[data-filter]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(location.hash==='#mine')tab=b.dataset.filter;else filter=b.dataset.filter;render(false)});if($('#export'))$('#export').onclick=exportBackup;if($('#import'))$('#import').onchange=importBackup;if($('#edit-profile'))$('#edit-profile').onclick=editProfile}
function bindOpen(){$$('[data-open]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{view='wall';location.hash='work/'+encodeURIComponent(b.dataset.open)})}
function treeHTML(root,items,current){function branch(x,seen=new Set(),depth=0){if(seen.has(x.id)||depth>30)return '';const next=new Set(seen);next.add(x.id);const children=items.filter(i=>i.parent===x.id);return `<li><button data-node="${esc(x.id)}" class="tree-node ${x.id===current?'selected':''}"><span>${icons[x.category]||'✧'}</span><b>${esc(x.title)}</b><small>${esc(x.author)}${x.mine?' · 我的藏品':''}</small></button>${children.length?`<ul>${children.map(c=>branch(c,next,depth+1)).join('')}</ul>`:''}</li>`}return `<div class="tree-scroll"><ul class="creation-tree">${branch(root)}</ul></div>`}
function work(id){const x=all().find(i=>i.id===id);if(!x)return `<section class="empty-state"><h1>这个故事暂时不在这里。</h1><a href="#explore" class="outline">返回开放展馆</a></section>`;currentId=id;const deleted=x.deleted,draft=x.draft;const root=C.rootOf(id,all()),related=available().filter(i=>C.rootOf(i.id,all())?.id===root.id),source=all().find(i=>i.id===x.parent);const permitted=!deleted&&!draft&&x.remix&&(!x.mine||x.visibility==='public');return `<section class="work-page"><a href="${x.mine?'#mine':'#explore'}" class="back-link">← 返回${x.mine?'个人':'开放'}展馆</a><div class="work-heading"><span class="eyebrow">A UNIVERSE OF POSSIBILITIES · 主题小展馆</span><h1>${esc(x.title)}</h1><p>由 ${esc(x.author)} 珍藏 · ${esc(x.category)} · ${esc(x.year)}${!x.mine?' · 示例藏品':''}</p></div><div class="work-layout"><div><div class="reading-book"><div class="book-spine"></div><div class="reading-content"><div class="reading-top"><span>${icons[x.category]||'✧'} ${esc(x.category)}</span><span>${x.mine?(deleted?'回收站':draft?'草稿':x.visibility==='private'?'私密封印':'本机公开'):'馆藏示例'}</span></div>${x.image&&C.imageSafe(x.image)?`<img class="work-image" src="${esc(x.image)}" alt="${esc(x.title)}">`:''}<h2>${esc(x.title)}</h2><div class="story">${esc(x.story)}</div>${x.link&&C.linkSafe(x.link)?`<a class="external-link" href="${esc(C.linkSafe(x.link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">打开附属作品链接 ↗</a>`:''}<div class="end-mark">✦ 未完 · 待续 ✦</div></div></div>${x.invitation?`<div class="invitation-note"><span>✧ 创作邀请</span><p>${esc(x.invitation)}</p></div>`:''}<section class="branches"><div class="branch-heading"><div><span class="eyebrow">THE STORY CONTINUES</span><h2>从这里，长出不同的可能。</h2></div><div class="segmented"><button id="wall-view" class="${view==='wall'?'active':''}">作品墙</button><button id="tree-view" class="${view==='tree'?'active':''}">创作树</button></div></div>${view==='tree'?treeHTML(root,related,id):`<div class="branch-wall">${related.filter(i=>i.id!==id).map(i=>`<button data-node="${esc(i.id)}"><span>${icons[i.category]||'✧'}</span><b>${esc(i.title)}</b><small>${esc(i.author)} · ${i.id===root.id?'原作':'延伸作品'}</small></button>`).join('')||'<p class="muted">这里还没有新的分支。原作本身，也值得被珍藏。</p>'}</div>`}</section>${!deleted&&!draft?commentsHTML(id):''}</div><aside class="work-aside"><span class="eyebrow">COLLECTION NOTES</span><h3>藏品展签</h3><dl><dt>收藏者</dt><dd>${esc(x.author)}</dd><dt>此刻的心情</dt><dd>${esc(x.mood)}</dd><dt>延伸授权</dt><dd>${x.remix?'允许延伸 · 保留署名':'仅供欣赏'}</dd></dl>${source?`<p>源自作品</p><button class="source-button" data-node="${esc(source.id)}">↳ ${esc(source.title)}</button>`:x.parent?'<p class="muted">来源作品未随备份导入，关联编号仍保留。</p>':''}<div class="aside-actions">${deleted?'<button id="restore-item" class="gold">恢复到收藏室</button>':draft?'<button id="edit-item" class="gold">继续编辑草稿</button>':`${permitted?'<button id="extend" class="gold">✧ 延伸创作</button>':'<p class="muted">这件藏品未开放延伸入口。</p>'}<button id="save-item">${saved.includes(id)?'♥ 已收藏':'♡ 收藏藏品'}</button><button id="like-item">${reactions[id]?'✦ 已点亮':'✧ 为故事点一盏灯'}</button><button id="find-idea">寻找灵感 ↗</button>${x.mine?'<button id="edit-item">编辑藏品与权限</button>':''}`}${x.mine&&!deleted?'<button id="delete-item" class="text-button">移入回收站</button>':''}</div><p class="aside-foot">所有互动仅保存在当前浏览器。<br>创作属于人，灵感不止一种答案。</p></aside></div></section>`}
function bindWork(){const x=all().find(i=>i.id===currentId);if(!x)return;$$('[data-node]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>location.hash='work/'+encodeURIComponent(b.dataset.node));if($('#wall-view'))$('#wall-view').onclick=()=>{view='wall';render(false)};if($('#tree-view'))$('#tree-view').onclick=()=>{view='tree';render(false)};if($('#save-item'))$('#save-item').onclick=()=>{const next=saved.includes(x.id)?saved.filter(i=>i!==x.id):[...saved,x.id];if(write('museum-saved',next)){saved=next;render(false);toast(saved.includes(x.id)?'金色书签已夹好':'已取消收藏')}};if($('#like-item'))$('#like-item').onclick=()=>{const next={...reactions,[x.id]:!reactions[x.id]};if(write('museum-reactions',next)){reactions=next;render(false)}};if($('#find-idea'))$('#find-idea').onclick=()=>openAssistant(x);if($('#extend'))$('#extend').onclick=()=>{sourceId=x.id;editingId=null;location.hash='create'};if($('#edit-item'))$('#edit-item').onclick=()=>{editingId=x.id;sourceId=null;location.hash='create'};if($('#delete-item'))$('#delete-item').onclick=()=>confirmAction('把它暂时收起来？','藏品会进入回收站，可以随时恢复；已有分支会保留来源记录。',()=>{if(commit(own.map(i=>i.id===x.id?{...i,deleted:true,updatedAt:Date.now()}:i))){tab='回收站';location.hash='mine';toast('已放入回收站，可随时恢复')}});if($('#restore-item'))$('#restore-item').onclick=()=>{if(commit(own.map(i=>i.id===x.id?{...i,deleted:false}:i))){render(false);toast('藏品已回到收藏室')}};if($('#comment-form'))$('#comment-form').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();const text=$('#comment-text').value.trim();if(!text)return;const next={...comments,[x.id]:[...(comments[x.id]||[]),{id:uid(),text,at:Date.now()}]};if(write('museum-comments',next)){comments=next;render(false);toast('心意已留下')}};$$('[data-delete-comment]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const next={...comments,[x.id]:(comments[x.id]||[]).filter(c=>c.id!==b.dataset.deleteComment)};if(write('museum-comments',next)){comments=next;render(false)}})}
function commentsHTML(id){const list=Array.isArray(comments[id])?comments[id]:[];return `<section class="comments"><h2>留下片刻心意 <small>本机留言 · ${list.length}</small></h2><form id="comment-form"><textarea id="comment-text" required maxlength="1000" rows="2" placeholder="告诉收藏者，哪一个片段让你停留？" aria-label="留言内容"></textarea><button class="outline" type="submit">留下心意 ↗</button></form><div>${list.map(c=>`<article><small>本机访客 · ${new Date(c.at).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}</small><p>${esc(c.text)}</p><button class="text-button" data-delete-comment="${esc(c.id)}">移除这条留言</button></article>`).join('')}</div></section>`}
function uid(){return globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.()||'item-'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}
function editor(){const x=editingId?own.find(i=>i.id===editingId):null;const source=sourceId?available().find(i=>i.id===sourceId):x?.parent?all().find(i=>i.id===x.parent):null;attachment=x?.image||'';return `<section class="editor-page"><a href="${x?'#work/'+encodeURIComponent(x.id):'#mine'}" class="back-link">← 暂时离开手稿台</a><div class="page-heading"><span class="eyebrow">THE WRITING DESK · 魔法手稿台</span><h1>${x?'重新整理这件珍藏':'为未完成，留一个位置。'}</h1><p>不必完整，不必精美。你愿意留下，它就值得被收藏。</p></div>${source?`<div class="local-notice">✧ ${x?'来源':'正在延伸'}：《${esc(source.title)}》 · 原作者 ${esc(source.author)}。来源关系与署名将保留。</div>`:''}<div class="editor-layout"><form id="entry-form"><label>藏品名字 <span>*</span><input name="title" required maxlength="70" value="${esc(x?.title||'')}" placeholder="给这个片段起个名字"></label><div class="form-row"><label>藏品形式<select name="category">${C.categories.map(c=>`<option ${x?.category===c?'selected':''}>${c}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>收藏者署名<input name="author" maxlength="30" value="${esc(x?.author||'一位收藏者')}" placeholder="可以使用化名"></label></div><label>作品与故事 <span>*</span><textarea name="story" required rows="9" maxlength="10000" placeholder="留下作品本身，也可以说说它为何停在这里。">${esc(x?.story||'')}</textarea><small id="word-count"></small></label><label>封面或图片 <small>JPG / PNG / WebP，最大 2 MB</small><input type="file" id="image-input" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"></label><div class="image-tools"><span id="image-state">${attachment?'已有图片，保存时将保留':'还没有选择图片'}</span><button type="button" id="remove-image" class="text-button">移除图片</button></div><label>外部作品链接 <small>音频、视频、项目等，可选</small><input name="link" type="url" value="${esc(x?.link||'')}" placeholder="https://…"></label><label>创作邀请 <small>可选</small><textarea name="invitation" rows="3" maxlength="1000" placeholder="希望其他人探索什么问题？">${esc(x?.invitation||'')}</textarea></label><label>此刻的心情<select name="mood">${C.moods.map(m=>`<option ${x?.mood===m?'selected':''}>${m}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><div class="permission-box"><label class="check"><input type="checkbox" name="public" ${x?.visibility==='public'?'checked':''}><span><b>在开放展馆展出</b><small>本机可见。关闭后，仅在个人展馆中保存。</small></span></label><label class="check"><input type="checkbox" name="remix" ${x?.remix?'checked':''}><span><b>允许延伸创作</b><small>独立于公开设置；参与者应保留作者与来源。</small></span></label></div><p class="form-note">藏品保存在当前浏览器；尚未接入云端与多人共享。发布前请检查私人信息，并保留原始文件。</p><p id="form-error" role="alert"></p><div class="button-row"><button class="gold" type="submit">${x&&!x.draft?'保存修改':'让手稿入藏'} ↗</button><button type="button" id="save-draft">保存草稿</button></div></form><aside class="editor-preview"><span class="eyebrow">A GLIMPSE OF YOUR COLLECTION</span><h3>它在展馆里的样子</h3><div id="live-preview"></div><p>每一件未完成，<br>都拥有自己的光。</p><button id="editor-inspire" class="outline">✧ 翻开灵感手札</button></aside></div></section>`}
function formData(){const f=$('#entry-form'),d=new FormData(f),prev=own.find(x=>x.id===editingId),source=all().find(x=>x.id===sourceId);return {id:prev?.id||uid(),title:String(d.get('title')||'').trim(),story:String(d.get('story')||'').trim(),author:String(d.get('author')||'').trim()||'一位收藏者',category:d.get('category'),mood:d.get('mood'),visibility:d.has('public')?'public':'private',remix:d.has('remix'),link:String(d.get('link')||'').trim(),invitation:String(d.get('invitation')||'').trim(),parent:prev?.parent||source?.id||null,root:prev?.root||(source?C.rootOf(source.id,all())?.id:null),image:attachment,year:prev?.year||String(new Date().getFullYear()),createdAt:prev?.createdAt||Date.now(),updatedAt:Date.now(),mine:true}}
let imageReading=false;function bindEditor(){const f=$('#entry-form');const update=()=>{const x=formData();$('#live-preview').innerHTML=card({...x,title:x.title||'你的未完成，正在这里',story:x.story||'故事从这里开始……'});$('#word-count').textContent=x.story.length+' / 10000';$('#live-preview button').disabled=true};update();f.oninput=update;$('#editor-inspire').onclick=()=>openAssistant(formData());$('#image-input').onchange=async e=>{const file=e.target.files[0];if(!file)return;if(file.size>2*1024*1024||!['image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp'].includes(file.type)){$('#form-error').textContent='请选择 2 MB 以内的 JPG、PNG 或 WebP 图片。';e.target.value='';return}imageReading=true;try{attachment=await new Promise((res,rej)=>{const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>res(r.result);r.onerror=rej;r.readAsDataURL(file)});$('#image-state').textContent=file.name;$('#form-error').textContent='';update()}catch{$('#form-error').textContent='图片读取失败，请重新选择。'}finally{imageReading=false}};$('#remove-image').onclick=()=>{attachment='';$('#image-input').value='';$('#image-state').textContent='未选择图片';update()};f.onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();saveEntry(false)};$('#save-draft').onclick=()=>saveEntry(true)}
function saveEntry(draft){if(imageReading){toast('图片正在读取，请稍候。');return}const x=formData();if(!x.title||(!draft&&!x.story)){$('#form-error').textContent=draft?'请先为草稿起个名字。':'请填写藏品名字和作品内容。';return}if(x.link&&!C.linkSafe(x.link)){$('#form-error').textContent='作品链接应以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。';return}if(!editingId&&sourceId){const source=available().find(i=>i.id===sourceId);if(!source?.remix||(source.mine&&source.visibility!=='public')){$('#form-error').textContent='来源藏品当前未开放延伸，请重新选择。';return}}let item;try{item=C.normalize({...x,draft})}catch(e){$('#form-error').textContent=e.message;return}const next=editingId?own.map(i=>i.id===editingId?item:i):[item,...own];if(!commit(next))return;editingId=null;sourceId=null;currentId=item.id;portalEffect(draft?'草稿已妥善收好':'手稿正在飞入书架');location.hash='work/'+encodeURIComponent(item.id);toast(draft?'草稿已保存，可在草稿箱继续':'手稿已入藏，新的可能从此开始。')}
function exportBackup(){const body={format:'unfinished-museum',version:2,exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),items:own,saved,reactions,comments,profile};const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(body,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}));const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='未完成博物馆-完整备份-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);toast('备份已导出，包含私密内容，请妥善保管。')}
async function importBackup(e){const file=e.target.files[0];if(!file)return;try{if(file.size>20*1024*1024)throw Error('备份不能超过 20 MB');const payload=JSON.parse(await file.text()),merged=C.mergeBackup(own,payload,demo.map(x=>x.id));confirmAction('恢复这份备份？',`将新增 ${merged.added} 件藏品，跳过 ${merged.skipped} 件已有藏品。不会覆盖现有内容。`,()=>{if(commit(merged.items)){if(!Array.isArray(payload)){const ids=new Set(all().map(x=>x.id));const next=[...new Set([...saved,...(Array.isArray(payload.saved)?payload.saved:[]).filter(x=>typeof x==='string'&&ids.has(x))])];if(write('museum-saved',next))saved=next;if(payload.comments&&typeof payload.comments==='object'){const nextComments={...comments};for(const [id,list] of Object.entries(payload.comments)){if(ids.has(id)&&!Object.hasOwn(nextComments,id)&&Array.isArray(list))nextComments[id]=list.filter(c=>c&&typeof c.text==='string').map(c=>({id:typeof c.id==='string'?c.id:uid(),text:c.text.slice(0,1000),at:Number(c.at)||Date.now()}))}if(write('museum-comments',nextComments))comments=nextComments}}render(false);toast(`恢复完成，新增 ${merged.added} 件藏品。`)}})}catch(err){toast('无法恢复：'+err.message)}finally{e.target.value=''}}
function editProfile(){const dialog=document.createElement('dialog');dialog.innerHTML=`<button class="close" aria-label="关闭">×</button><span class="eyebrow">YOUR OWN LITTLE WORLD</span><h2>为书房题个名字</h2><form><label>书房名字<input name="name" required maxlength="40" value="${esc(profile.name)}"></label><label>一句介绍<textarea name="bio" maxlength="200" rows="3">${esc(profile.bio)}</textarea></label><button class="gold" type="submit">保存布置</button></form>`;document.body.append(dialog);dialog.showModal();dialog.querySelector('.close').onclick=()=>dialog.close();dialog.onclose=()=>dialog.remove();dialog.querySelector('form').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();const d=new FormData(e.target),p={name:String(d.get('name')).trim(),bio:String(d.get('bio')).trim()};if(!p.name)return;if(write('museum-profile',p)){profile=p;dialog.close();render(false);toast('书房的名字已更新')}}}
function inspiration(){return `<section class="inspiration-page"><span class="eyebrow">FOLLOW A LITTLE SPARK</span><h1>灵感，藏在尚未回答的问题里。</h1><p>不必马上找到答案，先选择一个让你好奇的方向。</p><div class="prompt-grid">${[['✧','如果重来一次','把故事的最后一句，当作另一个人的第一句。'],['♬','换一种表达','如果把那封信变成声音，它会是什么节奏？'],['⌘','从小处开始','从宏大的计划里，找出今天能试的一个小动作。'],['▧','换一个视角','如果故事里的旁观者开口，会说出什么？']].map(([i,t,p])=>`<button data-prompt="${esc(p)}"><span>${i}</span><h2>${t}</h2><p>${p}</p><small>打开灵感手札 ↗</small></button>`).join('')}</div><a href="#explore" class="gold pill">去藏品里寻找一个起点 →</a></section>`}
function openAssistant(x=null,prompt=''){const context=x||all().find(i=>i.id===currentId);$('#assistant-context').textContent=context?'正在围绕《'+(context.title||'尚未命名的作品')+'》思考':'';$('#assistant').dataset.title=context?.title||'';$('#idea-input').value=prompt;$('#advice').innerHTML='<p>选择下面的一种方式，给思考一个小小的起点。</p>';$('#assistant').showModal()}
$('#orb').onclick=()=>openAssistant();$$('.assistant .close').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>$('#assistant').close());$$('[data-mode]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const idea=$('#idea-input').value.trim(),title=$('#assistant').dataset.title;const tips={'打开思路':['换一个时间：它发生在十年前或十年后，会有什么变化？','换一个讲述者：让原本沉默的人或物来表达。','换一种媒介：先画三个画面，或录下三种声音。'],'理清想法':['先写一句话：我希望读者感受到什么？','分别列出已经确定的内容，与暂时没有答案的部分。','只选一个想继续探索的问题，不必同时完成全部。'],'分析难点':['把障碍分成：不知道怎么做、缺少素材、缺少时间。','选最小的一项，用 20 分钟做一次粗略尝试。','写下这次尝试要验证什么，再决定是否继续。'],'寻找实现方法':['文字：先列三个关键场景，再写其中最清楚的一段。','影像：先做三格分镜，用手机拍一组静态试镜。','声音：先录环境音与节奏，用熟悉的音频工具做 30 秒草稿。']};$('#advice').innerHTML=`<small>本地手札 · ${esc(b.dataset.mode)}</small><h3>${title?'围绕《'+esc(title)+'》':'给这个想法一点空间'}</h3>${idea?`<p class="idea-echo">你的问题：${esc(idea)}</p>`:''}<ol>${tips[b.dataset.mode].map(t=>`<li>${t}</li>`).join('')}</ol><p class="muted">这些是预设引导，不是 AI 生成的回答；你可以自由取舍。</p>`});
function about(){return `<section class="about-page"><span class="eyebrow">A MUSEUM THAT NEVER FINISHES</span><h1>未完成，也是一种可能。</h1><p class="about-lead">一座由人类想象力持续扩建的魔法图书馆。</p><p>我们都有一些舍不得丢掉的未完成：一封没有寄出的信，一段停在前奏的旋律，一家只在笔记本里开过的店。它们不必拥有结局，也值得被珍藏。</p><h2>尊重每一种停留</h2><p>你可以私密保存，可以公开展出，也可以主动邀请别人继续。公开不代表授权；每件延伸作品，都应保留它的作者与来处。</p><h2>创作属于人</h2><p>灵感手札帮助打开思路与规划方法。当前版本使用本地预设引导，尚未连接 AI；它不会替你生成或发布完整作品。</p><h2>关于这次体验</h2><p>这是可交互的本地版本。账号、跨用户共享、云端备份与内容审核尚未接入。预置作品和互动内容为示例；你的新藏品只保存在当前浏览器。请定期导出备份，避免清除浏览数据造成丢失。</p><a href="#create" class="gold pill">留下我的第一件藏品 ↗</a></section>`}
function portalEffect(text){if(!motion||reduced.matches)return;const p=$('#portal');p.querySelector('span').textContent=text||'正在翻开新的篇章';p.classList.remove('active');void p.offsetWidth;p.classList.add('active');setTimeout(()=>p.classList.remove('active'),850)}
function render(scroll=true){const hash=location.hash||'#home';document.body.dataset.scene=hash==='#home'?'home':hash==='#mine'?'study':hash.startsWith('#work/')?'work':'gallery';$$('nav a').forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('active',a.getAttribute('href')===hash));const main=$('#main');if(hash==='#explore'){main.innerHTML=explore();bindGallery()}else if(hash==='#mine'){main.innerHTML=mine();bindGallery()}else if(hash==='#create'){main.innerHTML=editor();bindEditor()}else if(hash.startsWith('#work/')){let id;try{id=decodeURIComponent(hash.slice(6))}catch{id=''}main.innerHTML=work(id);bindWork()}else if(hash==='#about')main.innerHTML=about();else if(hash==='#inspire'){main.innerHTML=inspiration();$$('[data-prompt]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openAssistant(null,b.dataset.prompt))}else{main.innerHTML=home();bindOpen()}main.classList.remove('page-enter');void main.offsetWidth;main.classList.add('page-enter');if(scroll)window.scrollTo(0,0)}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const a=e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');if(!a)return;const hash=a.getAttribute('href');if(hash==='#rooms'||hash==='#main')return;if(hash==='#create'&&location.hash!=='#create'){editingId=null;sourceId=null}if(hash!==location.hash)portalEffect()});
window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{if(location.hash==='#rooms')return;query='';render()});window.addEventListener('storage',e=>{if(e.key==='museum-items'){const value=read('museum-items',[]);if(Array.isArray(value)){own=value;if(location.hash!=='#create')render(false)}}});
document.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(document.body.dataset.scene!=='home'||!motion||reduced.matches||innerWidth<900)return;document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--px',((e.clientX/innerWidth-.5)*10).toFixed(2)+'px');document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--py',((e.clientY/innerHeight-.5)*7).toFixed(2)+'px')});
render();
</script><script>/* Local binary storage. Files stay in this browser and are never uploaded. */
const MuseumMedia=(()=>{
 let database;
 const allowed=new Set(['audio/mpeg','audio/mp3','audio/wav','audio/x-wav','audio/ogg','audio/mp4','audio/webm','video/mp4','video/webm','video/quicktime']);
 function open(){if(!globalThis.indexedDB)return Promise.reject(Error('此浏览器无法保存音视频。请改用作品链接，或换一个支持本地存储的浏览器。'));if(database)return database;database=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const r=indexedDB.open('unfinished-museum-media',1);r.onupgradeneeded=()=>r.result.createObjectStore('files',{keyPath:'id'});r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result);r.onerror=()=>{database=null;reject(Error('无法打开附件存储，请检查浏览器权限。'))};r.onblocked=()=>{database=null;reject(Error('附件存储暂时被占用，请关闭其他展馆标签后重试。'))}});return database}
 async function put(id,file){if(!allowed.has(file.type))throw Error('请选择 MP3、WAV、OGG、M4A、MP4、MOV 或 WebM 文件。');if(file.size>20*1024*1024)throw Error('音视频附件最大 20 MB；较大的作品请使用链接。');const db=await open();return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const tx=db.transaction('files','readwrite');tx.objectStore('files').put({id,file});tx.oncomplete=()=>resolve({id,name:file.name,type:file.type,size:file.size});tx.onerror=()=>reject(Error('附件保存失败：本地空间不足或存储被禁止。原内容仍保留，可重试或改用链接。'));tx.onabort=tx.onerror})}
 async function get(id){const db=await open();return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const r=db.transaction('files','readonly').objectStore('files').get(id);r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result?.file||null);r.onerror=()=>reject(Error('附件读取失败，请重试。'))})}
 async function toBackup(meta){const file=await get(meta.id);if(!file)throw Error('附件“'+meta.name+'”不在当前浏览器，无法生成完整备份。');return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>resolve({...meta,data:r.result});r.onerror=()=>reject(Error('附件备份失败'));r.readAsDataURL(file)})}
 function decodeBackup(x){if(!x||typeof x.id!=='string'||typeof x.name!=='string'||!allowed.has(x.type)||typeof x.data!=='string'||!x.data.startsWith('data:'+x.type+';base64,'))throw Error('备份中的音视频格式无效');let binary;try{binary=atob(x.data.slice(x.data.indexOf(',')+1))}catch{throw Error('备份附件已损坏')}if(binary.length>20*1024*1024)throw Error('备份中有附件超过 20 MB');const bytes=Uint8Array.from(binary,c=>c.charCodeAt(0));return new File([bytes],x.name,{type:x.type})}
 return {put,get,toBackup,decodeBackup,allowed};
})();

const originalMine=mine;mine=function(){const html=originalMine();return html.replace('<div class="study-stats">',`<div class="seed-intro"><div><span class="eyebrow">A SEED OF WHAT MAY COME</span><p>把旧时光收好，等某一天，长出新的可能。</p></div><a class="gold pill" href="#create">✧ 收藏新的未完成</a></div><div class="study-stats">`)};

const oldEditor=editor;editor=function(){let html=oldEditor(),x=own.find(i=>i.id===editingId);pendingMedia=null;keptMedia=x?.media||null;html=html.replace('<form id="entry-form">',`<form id="entry-form"><label>这颗种子是什么？<select id="content-type" name="contentType">${seedTypes.map(t=>`<option ${x?.contentType===t?'selected':''}>${t}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>`).replace('作品与故事 <span>*</span>','作品 / 创作记录 <small>可选；也可只上传附件或填写想法</small>').replace('name="story" required','name="story"').replace('魔法手稿台','时光封种台').replace('为未完成，留一个位置。','收藏一颗，未完成的种子。').replace('<label>创作邀请',`<label>它为什么停在这里？ <small>可选</small><textarea name="unfinishedReason" maxlength="2000" rows="3" placeholder="可以解释，也可以留白。">${esc(x?.unfinishedReason||'')}</textarea></label><label>想对未来说的话 <small>可选</small><textarea name="futureMessage" maxlength="2000" rows="3" placeholder="也许有一天，我们会从这里继续。">${esc(x?.futureMessage||'')}</textarea></label><label>创作邀请`).replace('<label>外部作品链接',`<label>音乐或视频附件 <small>保存在本机，单个最大 20 MB</small><input type="file" id="media-input" accept="audio/mpeg,audio/mp3,audio/wav,audio/x-wav,audio/ogg,audio/mp4,audio/webm,video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime"></label><div class="image-tools"><span id="media-state">${keptMedia?esc(keptMedia.name):'支持 MP3 / WAV / OGG / M4A / MP4 / MOV / WebM'}</span><button type="button" id="remove-media" class="text-button">移除音视频</button></div><label>外部作品链接`).replace('让手稿入藏','封存展品').replace('<p id="form-error" role="alert"></p>','<p id="form-error" role="alert"></p><p class="ritual-hint">✧ 首次封种约 3.7 秒，之后自动简化。你可以随时跳过。</p>');return html};
const oldFormData=formData;formData=function(){const x=oldFormData(),f=$('#entry-form');return {...x,contentType:f.elements.contentType?.value||'文字',unfinishedReason:f.elements.unfinishedReason?.value.trim()||'',futureMessage:f.elements.futureMessage?.value.trim()||'',media:keptMedia}}
const oldBindEditor=bindEditor;bindEditor=function(){oldBindEditor();const f=$('#entry-form');const mapping={'文字':'文字与信笺','照片':'绘画与影像','绘画':'绘画与影像','音乐':'声音与旋律','视频':'绘画与影像','账号链接':'链接与档案','未验证的想法':'生活与计划','综合创意':'生活与计划'};$('#content-type').onchange=e=>{f.elements.category.value=mapping[e.target.value];f.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))};$('#media-input').onchange=e=>{const file=e.target.files[0];if(!file)return;if(!MuseumMedia.allowed.has(file.type)||file.size>20*1024*1024){$('#form-error').textContent='请选择支持的音视频文件（最大 20 MB）。较大文件可以使用链接。';e.target.value='';return}pendingMedia=file;$('#media-state').textContent=file.name+' · '+(file.size/1024/1024).toFixed(1)+' MB';f.elements.contentType.value=file.type.startsWith('audio/')?'音乐':'视频';f.elements.category.value=mapping[f.elements.contentType.value];f.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));$('#form-error').textContent=''};$('#remove-media').onclick=()=>{pendingMedia=null;keptMedia=null;$('#media-input').value='';$('#media-state').textContent='未选择音视频'};f.onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();saveEntry(false)};$('#save-draft').onclick=()=>saveEntry(true)};
saveEntry=async function(draft){if(seedSaving)return;if(imageReading){toast('图片正在读取，请稍候。');return}const f=$('#entry-form'),x=formData(),prev=own.find(i=>i.id===editingId);const err=$('#form-error'),submit=f.querySelector('[type="submit"]');err.textContent='';if(!x.title){err.textContent='请为这颗种子起个名字。';f.elements.title.focus();return}if(!draft&&!x.story&&!attachment&&!pendingMedia&&!keptMedia&&!x.link&&!x.unfinishedReason&&!x.futureMessage){err.textContent='留下一段文字、一份附件、一个链接，或一句想对未来说的话。';return}if(x.link&&!C.linkSafe(x.link)){err.textContent='请使用 http:// 或 https:// 开头的作品链接。';return}if(!editingId&&sourceId){const source=available().find(i=>i.id===sourceId);if(!source?.remix||(source.mine&&source.visibility!=='public')){err.textContent='来源藏品未开放延伸，原内容已保留。';return}}seedSaving=true;submit.disabled=true;$('#save-draft').disabled=true;submit.textContent='正在妥善保存…';let succeeded=false;
 try{let media=keptMedia;if(pendingMedia){media=await MuseumMedia.put(uid(),pendingMedia);keptMedia=media;pendingMedia=null}const item=C.normalize({...x,media,draft,sealedAt:!draft?(prev?.sealedAt||Date.now()):prev?.sealedAt||null});const items=editingId?own.map(i=>i.id===editingId?item:i):[item,...own];if(!commit(items))throw Error('本地保存未成功。填写内容和附件仍保留，请检查存储空间后重试。');succeeded=true;editingId=null;sourceId=null;currentId=item.id;

    !document.body.classList.contains('still') && !document.hidden;

    light.classList.remove('is-visible');

    frame = 0;
    lastTime = 0;
    placed = false;
  }

    frame = 0;

    y += (targetY - y) * ease;

 d.querySelector('#pages-feedback-download').onclick=()=>{if(!f.reportValidity())return;const text=f.elements.kind.value+'\n\n'+f.elements.content.value;const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}));const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='未完成博物馆-建议.txt';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);status.textContent='已生成建议文件，尚未发送。'};
 const repo=window.MUSEUM_PAGES?.repository;
 if(typeof repo==='string'&&/^https:\/\/github\.com\/[\w.-]+\/[\w.-]+$/.test(repo)){const p=d.querySelector('#pages-feedback-repository');p.append('也可以前往 GitHub 公开留言（需要 GitHub 账号，内容公开可见，请勿填写私人信息）。');const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=repo+'/issues/new/choose';a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener noreferrer';a.className='outline pill';a.textContent='前往 GitHub 留言 ↗';p.append(a)}
 render(false);
})();
</script></body></html>
